name: Elena Marsh
bio: Elena has taught tantra and breath-based practices for over twelve years, blending trauma-informed presence work with conscious touch. She founded Intimar to create small, unhurried spaces for people to come home to their bodies — alone or with a partner.

name: Marcus Oduya
bio: A former physiotherapist, Marcus now teaches conscious touch and nervous-system regulation, helping guests release tension the body has been holding for years. His sessions are equal parts playful and grounding.

name: Sana Farooqi
bio: Sana trained in Himalayan sound healing before bringing her practice to tantra retreats. She holds evening sound baths and closing ceremonies, guiding energy work across every Intimar gathering.

name: Theo Lindqvist
bio: Theo designs the seasonal, plant-forward menus that anchor every retreat day. He believes a shared, unhurried meal is as much a sensory practice as anything on the mat.
